scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.rmSync('backend/public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','public',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','backend/public',{recursive:true})"
